expression_comparison.chosen_because: The live discrepancy is Fed PATH versus a fully priced 25bp EVENT, which is a front-end cash-rate object. USD spot already moved on the meeting; 2s10s is a one-year extreme without a terminal-hike or extra-hike proof; CA-US is a percentile extreme with conflicted energy/labor closers; AU-NZ rates do not exist in the packet. Vol is not unusually compelling versus paying 2Y into the next inflation print.

considered_rates.assessment: Chosen. The dated 16 Sep hike is spent for 25bp; the 17 Sep official 2Y print of 4.67% (-7bp) is the event-complete gap; the inflation pipeline is the forward closer and lives in cash-rate expectations. Receive AU 2Y on 16 Sep housing (stamp duty -24% YoY, volumes -18%, prices >7% off peak) is a real catalyst but AU 2Y is last observed 2026-09-09, RBA F2 is a lagged weekly series not proof the market is unrepriced, and AU inflation gauge 82 can veto easing. Paying US 5Y/10Y is worse entry (5Y 98.8th five-year percentile, 10Y 99.4th) and owns term premium the packet does not catalyze.

Rejected. US 2s10s is 27bp as of 2026-09-17, 1.4th one-year percentile, -25bp over one month as 2Y +48bp versus 10Y +23bp. A flattener is stretching an already-extreme curve without a new dated hike being required for 2s10s specifically. A steepener requires inferring the 16 Sep hike was terminal; the packet has no dots/statement to that effect and the inflation pipeline contradicts it. Curve stretch is a yardstick, not a closer.

Rejected as the primary. CA-US 5Y -122bp as of 2026-09-16 is 0.2nd one-year percentile and 7.4th five-year; CA-US 2Y -139bp is 4.8th/4.7th. That is valuation. Closers conflict: BoC minutes flag energy pass-through (CA yields up) versus Saudi Oman workaround with oil easing (hawkish tail reduced) versus CA core near 2% and labor gauge 38 (BoC can stay easy). On FOMC day the spread went more negative (CA-US 2Y -7bp, 5Y -4bp), so the Fed event overwhelmed the BoC flag. Extremes can persist. AU-US 2Y +40.5bp is as-of 2026-09-09, pre-hike and stale. AU-NZ and NZ-US RV are unavailable (RBNZ B2 HTTP 403).
